newsitem.title: DENMARK: Moeller has 90 pct of Lithuanian shipyard.
newsitem.headline: Moeller has 90 pct of Lithuanian shipyard.

text.p: Danish energy and shipping group A.P. Moeller said on Thursday its Odense Shipyard subsidiary now owned around 90 percent of Lithuania's Klaipeda-based Baltic Yard.

"We now control about 90 percent of share capital in Baltic Yard. We originally bought up 43 percent, which grew to around 74 percent after the raising of additional capital. Last Monday we bought the Lithuanian state's remaining 16 percent holding," Odense director Kurt Andersen told Reuters.
"The yard has ample orders, it is fully occupied and planned investment programmes are going ahead," Andersen said.

He said a Moeller subsidiary had ordered two new tugs from the yard, with a third on option. He did not expect that Moeller would attempt to buy out the remaining 10 percent shareholding held largely by Baltic Yard employees.
